nom: Knours. PDRN Rice & Green Tea Clarifying Toner

avis.texte: This toner sets my skin in a nice balance and prepares it for my additional serums and moisturizers in my morning and evening routine.
The formula feels gentle yet effective, perfect for sensitive skin. It helps to calm redness, maintain hydration, and leave my skin smooth. My face feels clean but never stripped or tight.

avis.titre: Leaves skin super soft and supple!
avis.texte: This toner has a slight richness to its texture, and once applied, it melts into the skin with a silky finish, leaving it soft and supple. I love that its fragrance-free and provides the perfect base for the next steps in my skincare routine.

As someone who has been using clarifying toners since I was 15 years old and now in my late 30s, I was always hoping Knours would release one so I could pair it with the One Perfect Moisturizer. And now that they have, I could not be happier! I use this with the Phyto Mucin moisturizer, and I love the pairing so much. After cleansing my skin, I dab this onto a cotton pad and swipe the pad over my face, and I can just feel the toner cleaning up whatever the cleanser left out. My skin feels refreshed and ready to take on moisturizer.

This toner is so gentle and absorbed very quickly into my skin. By the next morning, my skin was glowing! At first, I thought it felt light, but it turned out to be surprisingly moisturizing—I could still feel the hydration hours later. One small thing I'd like to mention: the bottle is a bit small… Could you please make a larger size? I'd definitely buy it!
Cleans so well and still leaves my skin comfortable, without drying out my skin!
Leaves my skin feeling clean, refreshed, and perfectly balanced.

This toner feels really light, but it's very hydrating! I love the texture and how it makes my skin feel soft and smooth after use. I follow up with the serum from this line and these are both perfect for my sensitive skin!
Very lightweight but rich texture. I used to use the foam toner so comparing to that, this has a richer texture but how it absorbs to skin is just so perfectly weighted and great prep step too.
Goes on fresh and smooth, leaves my skin feeling clean and refined, and absorbs beautifully. I'll definitely buy again.
